focus: Routing-accuracy testing design on top of the existing corpus, baseline gate, reach probe and drift guard
noveltyJustification: The routing-accuracy corpus, baseline gate policy, and reach-probe semantics are new evidence; the slice design composes them and adds measured seed sets.
keyQuestions: How should routing accuracy be tested, and which existing test seams should the harness reuse?
answeredQuestions: How should routing accuracy be tested, and which existing test seams should the harness reuse?
ruledOut: Building a new accuracy harness from scratch
Reusing ci-router-vocabulary-reach.cjs unchanged for doctor commands

keyFindings.title: Corpus infrastructure exists: 195 labeled, 66 holdout, 24 ambiguity cases with capture scripts
Baseline JSON pins top-1 0.7949, UNKNOWN 13, false-fire 5, holdout 0.7424
Bounded-delta gate is existing policy; doc numbers trail the JSON baseline
advisor_validate runs corpus, holdout, parity, safety and latency slices
Reach probe semantics: multi-word phrases, pinned allowlist, winner-sensitive
Reach harness filters to mode-registry hubs, so doctor needs its own probe source
Corpus record schema supports a doctor slice without changes
Doctor golden set: onboarding, diagnostics, control and ambiguity slices seeded from measurements
Slice gates: 9/9 onboarding, 12/14 diagnostics, 10/10 controls, no new ambiguity, doctor empty-rate 0
CI wiring: structural gates stay, outcome gate is the captured doctor slice, reach check gains a doctor mode
